lines.intro: In this lesson, you'll add an enemy that bounces around the screen. If it touches you, your score goes back to zero.
lines.recap: The player and the coin are folded up. {enemy}Our new sprite is define sprite enemy.
lines.create: From {click}Program, drag {grab}create sprite under the coin's. {pick}Pick enemy, {x}and put it in a corner, at 300, 20.
lines.look: From {click}Looks, {grab}look like a circle goes into define sprite enemy. {box}Make it a box, size 18, and {red}red.
lines.direction: Also from {click}Looks, {grab}point in direction, with {num}40, to fly on a slant.
lines.fly: Then {click}forever: {motion}move forward 2 steps, and {bounce}bounce off the edges.
lines.hit: Inside the forever, {click}an if, with {sensing}touching sprite player.
lines.reset: When it hits you, from {click}Variables, {grab}set score to 0, and {sound}play sound hit.
lines.back: And from {click}Motion, {grab}go to x 300, y 20, {x}so the enemy starts again from its corner.
lines.playing: Catch the coins, and keep away from the red box, or your score drops to zero.
lines.code: In the code, {bounce}moving forward became advance, and bounce became four IFs, one for each edge of the screen.
lines.outro: Well done! {next}In lesson five, it's free play: make your own game.
